rules.title: A list that ends in etc.
rules.text: An enumeration that closes with `etc.`, `and so on` or `and more` tells the reader the list was never finished: either the items matter and belong there, or they do not and the list should end where it ends. Name the last item, or name what the rest have in common.

judgement.question: Does this line close an enumeration with `etc.`, `and so on` or `and more`?

criteria.true: the line ends a list of examples with `etc.`, `and so on` or `and more`, leaving the reader to guess what the list did not name
criteria.false: `etc.` sits inside a path, filename or code span; `more` modifies a noun rather than closing a list (more history); or the line quotes another project's own text
